subject: HelioRetail renewal coverage & benchmark response
messages:
From: Allison Park <allison@helioretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + upcoming bake-off

Karthik,

We're coming up on our renewal with Redwood in June and I wanted to flag that we've had a competing commercial engagement with ZephyrAI that surfaced last week. Procurement asked us to run a short benchmark to validate latency/cost for our peak traffic (holiday simulations).

High level: HelioRetail is evaluating a 2x capacity increase for Q4 (higher request concurrency for our shopper search and personalization flows). Zephyr is pitching a price-first play. They promised a throughput demo next week.

Before procurement kicks off an RFP, can you share:
- Typical 99th percentile generation latency for a 2k token window on dedicated nodes
- Any recent Helio-specific benchmark material you can share
- Options for reserved capacity (burst, surge) and short-term pilot pricing

Attached is our current usage summary so you can see the shape of traffic. We value Redwood's reliability and observability — but procurement will need clear numbers.

Thanks,
Allison Park
Director, Engineering
HelioRetail

Attachments: current_usage_summary.csv (text/csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Allison Park <allison@helioretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + upcoming bake-off

Allison — thanks for the heads up and the usage file. I copied Lauren (AM) and Grace (SE) to run a targeted bench and propose coverage.

Quick asks from our side so we scope the tests correctly:
- Can you confirm peak concurrent preds and 99th token length distribution? (I flagged the CSV but a short note is helpful)
- Is the bake-off focused purely on cost or are there feature gaps (observability, KV cache persistence, support SLA) in scope?

We can turn around a short benchmark doc and a pilot proposal by EOD Tuesday (13th). If helpful, let's set a 30-min sync next week — I'll propose windows.

-Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Allison Park <allison@helioretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@helioretail.com>, procurement@helioretail.com
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + upcoming bake-off

Karthik — thanks. Peak concurrency: ~1,800 simultaneous requests during spikes; median request size ~600 tokens; top 10% of requests are ~1.8k tokens.

Procurement wants both cost and perf data. Observability is a differentiator for us (token-level cost, per-route dashboards). Zephyr does not have the same transparency, and CS asked whether Redwood will provide a short-term reserved pool for Q4 while we scale.

We'll be ready for a bench next week — can you deliver the test harness and expected metrics?

-Allison
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Allison Park <allison@helioretail.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood benchmark summary + recommended coverage

Allison / team — thanks for the data. Attached are the detailed benchmark results run against a Helio-like workload, plus a cost comparison spreadsheet. High level summary: 

- 99th-percentile generation latency (2k token window) on Dedicated c5-gpu-dedicated-xx: 420ms
- Sustained throughput: 2,200 requests/sec with batching and KV cache enabled (test harness simulates your peak pattern)
- Under burst (2.5x traffic) we observe graceful degradation: queuing increases but latency stays <1s for 95% of requests with autoscale enabled

Methodology: we used the same model family you run in production, warm state KV cache for repeated prompts, and a 10-minute cold-start window for one of the runs to highlight warm vs cold behavior. Full methodology is in the attached PDF.

Recommended coverage for Q4 expansion:
- Dedicated reserved pool sized for 2x current steady-state (with 30% burst headroom)
- Pilot period: 6 weeks with telemetry hooks enabled (we'll provide route-level dashboards and token-cost breakdowns)
- Commercial concession: 10% off list for a 6-month committed term + two weeks of free burst credits to test holiday traffic

I've attached: redwood_benchmark_helioretail.pdf (pdf), cost_comparison.xlsx (xlsx), and a one-page renewal_term_sheet.pdf with the proposed commercial bullets. Happy to walk through on a call.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Allison Park <allison@helioretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed renewal terms for HelioRetail (summary)

Allison — following Grace's bench and Karthik's convo, here's a succinct proposal we can package for procurement: 

- Term: 12 months with option to extend to 24; committed reserved capacity sized for 2x steady-state, with an auto-burst policy (30% headroom)
- Commercial: 10% discount off published Dedicated rates for first 6 months; additional token credits to cover two-week holiday burst testing
- SLA: 99.9% uptime for dedicated pool; dedicated support lane and monthly playbook review during Q4
- Next steps: If that looks acceptable, I can upload a redlined term sheet to DocuSign and loop legal.

Rishi — can you confirm final approval on the concession and pricing cadence?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Allison Park <allison@helioretail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, procurement@helioretail.com
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed renewal terms for HelioRetail (summary)

Lauren / team — this looks good and aligns with the internal ask. Procurement will review the 12-month term + concession. Please send the redlined term sheet and the DocuSign link. We're prioritizing vendors that can show clear holiday readiness.

Also — can you include a short appendix in the DocuSign packet with the benchmark highlights so procurement has the numbers inline? That speeds approvals.

We'll aim to return a countersigned DocuSign by 5/6 if everything is in order.

Thanks,
Allison Park
Director, Engineering
HelioRetail

Attachments referenced in thread: current_usage_summary.csv (text/csv); redwood_benchmark_helioretail.pdf (application/pdf); cost_comparison.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); renewal_term_sheet.pdf (application/pdf)
